headlines.title: Trump Says No Pause to Tariffs as He Targets China for Retaliation
headlines.abstract: The president said he would counter Beijing’s tariffs, which came in response to Mr. Trump’s own levies, with even more tariffs on Chinese imports.

headlines.abstract: The president further raised already steep tariffs on China, saying that Beijing should not have retaliated against his earlier trade actions.
